summary.business_type: SaaS directory / data platform — open-source repository intelligence (C-Rank telemetry). Not local service; light e-commerce (Pro $5/$39, $10 audit reports).
top_findings: Raw scorecard data corruption (facebook/react: merge rate 6666.7%, Stars 0, Language Other) — cited by AI, discredits brand
/pr-simulator mis-indexed: client component, wrong title, canonical points to /
Homepage 3 H1s + H1 opacity:0 until hydration — LCP/CLS risk on landing page
Guide template renders duplicate H1; GFI + guide titles truncate in SERPs
Repo-page orphan risk: zero lateral repo links, RelatedRepos empty — 101k long-tail pages reachable only via sitemap
Paid Repo Boost placements lack rel=sponsored — policy risk
Uppercase /Rankings/Python 200s junk repo page; /dashboard OAuth hop ends 404
quick_wins: Cap merge rate at 100% + backfill stars/description/language on raw scorecards
Single static-visible H1 on homepage; demote duplicate guide H1
rel=sponsored on boosted placements + rel=ugc on community links
Allowlist read-only /api/v1 GETs in robots.txt (llms.txt advertises them)
